name: MAIN - Detail two parts of an Image
author: Pfannkuchensack
description: Parent workflow: improve two regions of an image one after the other, e.g. face then hands, each with its own model type and settings.
notes:
Pfannkuchensacks Workflow Package

Two detail passes in sequence. Stage 2 works on the OUTPUT of stage 1, so the
improvements accumulate instead of overwriting each other.

Defaults are Face then hands, but "Body Part" is just a Grounding DINO text
prompt - eyes, teeth, hair, jewellery, anything the detector can name.

Why almost everything exists twice: the two stages may use different model
types, and the regions differ anyway. Hands usually need a lower detection
threshold (they are harder to find than faces) and a lower Denoising Start (more
change, because hands are what models get wrong). A single shared value would be
wrong for one of the two.

Shared on purpose: the input image, the negative prompt, the seed and Detail
Size. Those describe the picture or the process, not the region.

If stage 1 finds nothing, the run fails at the crop before stage 2 ever starts -
lower that stage's Detection Threshold to ~0.2 and retry.

Steps and CFG must match the model each stage points at: SDXL ~30 steps at CFG
5-8, Krea-2-Turbo 8 steps at CFG 1.0, FLUX ~25 steps at guidance ~3.5.
